# Juan Mackie

> Juan Mackie is an Australian operator, builder, and writer working at the intersection of fire protection, field-service operations, practical AI, and business design. He builds automation systems for real-world operational work and documents what survives contact with it.

Core thesis: fire protection and field service run on repetitive operational work — hours, callouts, scheduling, paperwork, compliance deadlines. AI should automate the mechanical parts (summarising, extracting, routing, drafting) while certified judgment, compliance decisions, and safety calls stay with people.

## Pages

- [Home](https://juanmackie.com/): Overview of Juan Mackie: current work, projects archive, writing, podcast, FAQ.
- [Thesis](https://juanmackie.com/thesis): The full argument for AI and automation in fire-protection field operations — what AI helps with, what stays human-controlled.
- [Work](https://juanmackie.com/work): Public archive of released tools and products, plus maintained forks with clear provenance, each linked to a public repository or live product surface.
- [Work: Prompt Paul](https://juanmackie.com/work/prompt-paul): Context-aware Chrome extension for selected text, page, media, document, web-grounded, and guarded page-action workflows. Case study.
- [Work: Logseq Housekeeper](https://juanmackie.com/work/logseq-housekeeper): Tool that scans Logseq graphs for unlinked mentions and proposes sensible wikilinks. Case study.
- [Work: Route-O-Matic](https://juanmackie.com/work/route-o-matic): Routing and map-optimisation experiments for field-service days. Case study.
- [Work: Fire-protection operations](https://juanmackie.com/work/fire-protection-operations): Ongoing administrative workflow automation inside fire-protection field service. Details intentionally general.
- [Work: SuretyDoc](https://juanmackie.com/work/suretydoc): Retired production project; product details remain private.
- [Free LLM Tracker](https://juanmackie.com/free-llm-tracker): Daily list of free OpenRouter models with Artificial Analysis scores where available.
- [Method](https://juanmackie.com/method): Six-step operating method: observe the workflow, find the bottleneck, preserve judgment, automate the mechanical parts, measure, productise last.
- [Writing](https://juanmackie.com/writing): Notes on AI, business, investing, tools, and systems. RSS available at /writing/rss.xml.
- [Agent memory stack](https://juanmackie.com/writing/our-agent-memory-stack-how-it-works): Answer to "agent memory stack SQLite Mnemosyne two-loop architecture" — a two-loop design around SQLite and Mnemosyne, with an inner per-turn memory loop and an outer scheduled consolidation loop.
- [About](https://juanmackie.com/about): Background and contact.
- [Direction](https://juanmackie.com/direction): What Juan is building toward.

## Current public work

- [Last P](https://github.com/juanmackie/Last-P-extension): A pi extension that puts a five-word summary of the latest prompt in the status bar, with a local fallback.
- [finalcut.ai](https://www.finalcut.ai/): A social platform for AI agents. The public site is live; adoption has not been measured.
- [Prompt Paul](https://www.promptpaul.juanmackie.com/): A context-aware browser AI assistant for selected text, pages, media, documents, web grounding, and guarded page actions.
- [pi-deepseek-peak](https://github.com/juanmackie/pi-deepseek-peak): A pi package that shows DeepSeek's PEAK/OFF-PEAK pricing phase and account health in the status bar.
- [Logseq Housekeeper](https://github.com/juanmackie/Logseq-housekeeper): A tool that scans Logseq graphs for unlinked mentions and adds sensible wikilinks.
- [ccswap](https://github.com/juanmackie/ccswap): A cross-platform CLI for switching Claude Code settings profiles.
- [utilviewer](https://juanmackie.github.io/utilviewer/): A browser tool for viewing .util archives. Processing happens locally.
- [Vectra](https://juanmackie.github.io/vectra/): A browser tool for making mathematical patterns and exporting SVG or PNG.
- [WhatsApp Desktop Webapp](https://github.com/juanmackie/WhatsApp-Desktop-Webapp): A lightweight desktop wrapper for WhatsApp Web, with a public Windows installer.
- [Ecovacs GOAT G1 beacon planner](https://juanmackie.github.io/Ecovacs-G1-beacon-placement-optimiser/): An unofficial planner for placing Ecovacs GOAT G1 beacons.
- [Free LLM Tracker](https://juanmackie.com/free-llm-tracker): A public tracker for free and open-source AI models, using current model and benchmark data.
- [mnemosyne-hermes](https://github.com/juanmackie/mnemosyne-hermes): A local-first memory and agent-orchestration system for Hermes and MCP-compatible agents; forked from rand/mnemosyne and materially adapted here.
